question: Calculate the total reportable net revenue across all orders in the database.

conditions.name: A_single_deleted_rule
rules: Exclude orders belonging to deleted customers.

conditions.name: A_single_verified_rule
rules: Include orders only from verified customers.

conditions.name: A_single_join_rule
rules: Aggregate payments and refunds separately per order before joining them to avoid join fan-out.

conditions.name: B_combined_rules
rules: Exclude orders belonging to deleted customers.
Include orders only from verified customers.
Aggregate payments and refunds separately per order before joining them to avoid join fan-out.

conditions.name: C_reordered_rules
rules: Aggregate payments and refunds separately per order before joining them to avoid join fan-out.
